readout_other: heat and pressure pain thresholds; contact heat-evoked potentials; pain-evoked time-frequency power; resting-state EEG connectivity; PANAS; SAM
direction_notes: Real versus sham tFUS raised heat and pressure pain thresholds, prolonged CHEP P2 latency, reduced heat pain-evoked alpha power and attenuated beta-band resting-state connectivity.
safety_notes: At least one adverse event in 13/28 after real vs 6/28 after sham; all mild or moderate, mostly drowsiness, resolved by 24 h; no serious events. Thermal and MI estimated by BabelBrain simulation in one participant.

exposures.label: Right M1 tFUS, 15 min, real vs sham crossover

device.manufacturer: Beijing RuAo Medical Technology Co., Ltd.

timing.protocol_description: Generator output 8 W, PRF 100 Hz, duty cycle 5%, pulse duration 500 us; each 500 ms sonication followed by a 10 s interval, 86 sonications over the 15 min intervention. One session per condition, at least one week apart.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of 28 healthy volunteers were recruited through poster or social media.
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: Methods This randomized, sham-controlled crossover study included 28 healthy adults, who completed a total of 56 experimental sessions.
